title: Example multi-clip anime scene — edit before starting

defaults.negative_prompt: frozen frame, warped anatomy, flashing, flicker, discontinuous backgrounds, extra fingers, watermark

segments.prompt: Anime cinematic animation, the subject looks around attentively and turns slightly toward the camera; subtle expressive eyes, natural hair and clothing motion, smooth movement, consistent character design
Continue the same scene: the subject takes a few slow deliberate steps forward as the camera follows; maintain the same face, clothing, environment and natural motion
Continue forward from the prior shot: subject pauses, glances toward the horizon, and the camera gently pushes closer; preserve the same setting and proportions
